verdict.rationale: Mangopay's wallet infrastructure supports splitting funds and platforms have their fees automatically wired to their bank account monthly, which supports taking a fee/markup on transactions (mangopay-docs-5, mangopay-docs-10, mangopay-docs-11). However, there is no evidence of per-seller custom pricing configuration or of dashboard/reporting that separates fee revenue from processing costs. Missing for 10: per-seller/variable fee-setting documentation, dedicated revenue-vs-cost reporting/dashboard evidence, independent confirmation of fee mechanics in production.
